note: One entry per training. Each has its own 3D model (web/app/models/<model>.js) and its own training material (web/data/<id>/parts.json and procedures.json); citations come from the shared sources.json. stage: metres, in the model's own frame. home = the opening orbit, floorY/floorRadius = the ground disc, focusDist = default fly-to distance (a part's own focusDist wins), maxDist = how far the trainee may zoom out, depthRef = see ipdFactorFor in web/app/view.js.
